edit.old: an ordinary classifier (个, 本, 只, 位) is dropped (三本书 → `书 :quant 3`).
edit.new: an ordinary classifier is kept as the unit too: a numeral + classifier phrase (一份, 一个, 三本) → `:quant N :unit (x / <classifier>)` (三本书 → `书 :quant 3 :unit (b / 本)`; 一份小报 → `小报 :quant 1 :unit (f / 份)`).

edit.anchor: Chinese names are split into words, not characters: 欧洲议会 → `:op1 "欧洲" :op2 "议会"`.
edit.text: The title marks 《 》 around a publication's name are name tokens: include them as the first and last `:opN`.

edit.new: *but* (但是, 却, 然而, 不过) `but-91` — `but-91` and `contrast-91` take `:ARG1` and `:ARG2`, never `:opN`;
*because* (因为, 由于) → `:reason`; 以 X 而 Y (*known for X*) → Y `:reason` X;

edit.anchor: A discontinuous word (帮……忙) is one concept aligned to its span.
edit.text: An adjectival chengyu modifying a noun (荒诞不经的内容) is a `:mod` concept, not an event (no aspect, no temporal or modal triples).

Frequent choices:
- A country or region modifying a noun (美国小报) → `:place (c / country ...)`, not `:mod`.
- The channel or medium (电视节目, 网络) → `:medium`.
- A version or part of a publication or object (X的纸本) → `:part-of`, not `:possessor`.
- Adverbs 已经, 都, 也, 仍, 还 are kept as `:mod` nodes on the e...

edit.anchor: | `process` | an event nominal, or a process whose type cannot be told (*the meeting*, 探索 as a noun) |
edit.text:
- Characteristic or repeated activities of a person or institution (publishing 发行, broadcasting, selling, compiling content 综合) are `habitual` even without a frequency word, and even with 了 when the clause describes what the entity does in general.
- 已经 + a change-of-state verb used as a modifier ...

edit.new: (*nowadays*, 现在, 目前) is a `:temporal` modifier of its event in the graph. It gets no triple of its own: anchor the event instead (e.g. to `document-creation-time`).

edit.anchor: - Annotate event–event relations only when they are clear.
edit.text:
- Do not give a temporal parent to a copular/identity predicate (`identity-91`) or to a property used as a modifier.
- Within a sentence, anchor the main event to `document-creation-time`, and anchor the dependent events (relative clauses, 以…而 reasons, related states) to that main event, not each t...

edit.old: - `:degree` for intensifiers and downtoners (*very, too, most*; 很, 非常, 太, 最) as a concept:
edit.new:
- A comparative or superlative (最, 更, *most*, *-er*) → `have-degree-91` (`:ARG1` the entity, `:ARG2` the property, `:ARG3` 最/更 or `most`/`more`).
- `:degree` only for intensifiers and downtoners (*very, too*; 很, 非常, 太) as a concept:

edit.old: - `(earlier :same-event later)`: two mentions of the same event.
edit.new: - `(earlier :same-event later)`: two mentions of the same event — only when the participants are the same. Stopping a whole paper and stopping only its print edition are different events.

edit.text:
## Examples

- Classifier (2.2): 一份小报 → `(x / 小报 :quant 1 :unit (f / 份))`.
- Title marks (2.2): 《世界新闻周报》 → `:name (n / name :op1 "《" :op2 "世界" :op3 "新闻" :op4 "周报" :op5 "》")`.
- Aspect (4.1):
  - 发行 for a newspaper → `:aspect habitual`.
  - 已经停止发行的 (modifier) → `停止-01 :aspect state :mod (y / 已经)`.
